title: NarrativeBeatV0
description: Projection of a real Enigma hop or structured result into an optional user-visible jot. Not a cognition log. Not C39 agent handoff. See docs/architecture/narrator.md and ADR-027.

event.description: Underlying hop or result id (e.g. availability.checked). Must exist; do not invent.

fact_refs.description: Structured fact ids the line may mention. Empty ⇒ line must not assert facts.

line.description: Optional NORMAL jot. Null/absent = suppressed. Must not outrun fact_refs.

suppress.description: True when this actor/hop is irrelevant this turn (e.g. silent Titan).

mythic_frame.description: Optional fictional frame tag (tarot, stargazing). Never a fact source.

notes.description: Author reminder. Not a status override.
